_doc: Pictures for the website's guide cards and guides (meridian-shards-website /guides, its scripts/optimise-images.mjs), in the format of backgrounds.json: the 3D view alone, no interface. Take them with `npm run shots -- --manifest guides.json --client modern`. The magic shots teach Shardshots the spell they cast (it's an admin, so casting is free), place a training dummy in the Outskirts of Raza if none stands there, and make an enormous unholy longsword if it isn't in hand (putting away any other weapon held); their scripts freeze the scene at the moment the picture shows.

shots.title: Frular in the Guildmaster's Hall
shots.note: Frular stands behind his counter at 5,7 facing south (barlqrm/gmhall.kod); from 9,7 facing north and looking up, the counter's canopy and pillars round him and the crown banner behind.

shots.title: A fireball down the path
shots.note: Outskirts of Raza in the afternoon, on the path facing south to a training dummy five squares down it (placed if there is none); first person, frozen 30% of the way there.

shots.title: Kraanan's Bless
shots.note: The same spot, the chase camera behind and above: Bless on yourself, its pulse of red diamonds frozen as it rises.

shots.title: An enormous unholy longsword
shots.note: The same spot, the chase camera close in front: the unholy longsword (made and wielded unless it is in hand) and its ring.

shots.title: Tos's fountain square
shots.note: The streets of Tos in the afternoon, the storm cleared, from above the square: the townsfolk crossing it.

shots.title: A melee in the Arena of Kraanan
shots.note: The Arena of Kraanan in the afternoon, the storm cleared, first person from the north stands looking down on the floor, during a bout of the relay's show.

shots.title: The Barloque Assizes
shots.note: The Office of the Justicar, first person from beside Caramo's desk, looking across the court to the bench while a case is heard.

shots.title: The Duke's chambers
shots.note: The Chambers of Duke Akardius, first person from the steps: the Duke and his court in purple.
